facts.fact_text: The Movement for an Independent and Federal Cyprus organises bi-communal meetings of a political, cultural, medical or social character.
The purpose of the Movement for an Independent and Federal Cyprus is to develop close relations between the two communities (Turkish-Cypriot and Greek-Cypriot).
The applicant is normally unable to obtain a permit from the Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot authorities to visit the "buffer-zone".
The applicant is normally unable to obtain a permit from the Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot authorities to visit the southern part of Cyprus in order to participate in various bi-communal meetings.

Between 8 March 1992 and 14 April 1998 (the date of the Commission's admissibility decision), only 6 out of 46 requests by the applicant for permits to visit the "buffer-zone" or the southern part of Cyprus were granted.
Between 18 April 1998 and 16 October 1999, two permit requests by the applicant were refused by the Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot authorities.

On 18 May 1994, the Directorate of Consular and Minority Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Defence of the "TRNC" informed the applicant that the permission requested by the applicant's letter of 19 April 1994 was refused for security reasons, in the public interest, and because the applicant had made propaganda against the State.
